nl: Name the three largest files under exports/ (searched recursively), largest first.
oracle_program: find "exports" type: file sort: size order: desc |> first 3 |> select path size
reference_pwsh: Get-ChildItem exports -Recurse -File | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Length) $($_.Name)" }
